errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.offline: You are offline. Showing the last data loaded.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the Dhoblio API.
errors.notFoundBody: That page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
errors.forbiddenBody: Your admin role does not have access to this area.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.notAdmin: That account is not an admin account.
errors.traceHint: Quote this request ID when asking for help:

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.subtitle: Dhoblio operations panel
login.invalid: That email and password do not match.
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes.
login.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
login.customerHint: Customers, vendors and riders sign in with their phone number, not here.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: Review applications, approve vendors and manage their standing.
vendors.emptyHint: New applications appear as soon as a vendor submits one.
vendors.approveBody: They will appear in customer search straight away, provided they are open and have an active catalogue.
vendors.rejectBody: The vendor sees this reason, so write something they can act on.
vendors.suspendBody: They disappear from search immediately. Orders already in progress are not cancelled.
vendors.reactivateBody: They become visible in search again.
vendors.reasonPlaceholder: What the vendor needs to fix, or why they were refused
vendors.suspendReasonPlaceholder: Why this vendor is being suspended
vendors.cnicRevealed: CNIC revealed. This has been written to the audit log.
vendors.cnicHint: Revealing a CNIC is recorded in the audit log against your account.
vendors.documentsHint: Links expire after a few minutes. Reload the page to get fresh ones.

riders.title: Riders
riders.subtitle: Approve rider applications and manage who can take jobs.
riders.emptyHint: A rider appears here once they apply through the rider app.
riders.approveBody: They can go online and start accepting jobs.
riders.suspendBody: They are taken offline and cannot accept new jobs. Jobs already accepted are not reassigned automatically.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Find an order, see where it is, and step in when support needs it.
orders.emptyHint: Orders appear here as soon as customers place them.
orders.timelineUnavailable: The history could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
orders.deliveryNone: No pickup or drop job yet.
orders.deliveryUnavailable: Delivery legs could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
orders.internal: Internal — never shown to the customer
orders.cancelBody: Order {orderNo} will be cancelled and any open pickup or drop job cancelled with it. The reason is recorded in the order history and shown to the customer and the vendor.
orders.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why this order is being cancelled

delivery.title: Dispatch
delivery.subtitle: Pickup and drop jobs, and the riders carrying them.
delivery.emptyHint: Jobs appear when a vendor accepts an order and again when it is ready.
delivery.assignBody: Only approved riders in this city are listed.
delivery.noRidersInCity: No approved riders in this city
delivery.noRidersInCityHint: Approve a rider for this city, or hand the city to a courier partner.
delivery.offlineWarning: That rider is offline. They will only see this job when they next come online.
delivery.unassignBody: The job returns to the pool and this rider is skipped on the next round of offers.
delivery.failBody: Use this when the job genuinely cannot be completed. The reason is recorded.
delivery.redispatchBody: Dispatch starts another round, widening the radius until a rider accepts.
delivery.redispatchDone: Job sent back out for dispatch.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: Vendors asking to be paid what the ledger says they have earned.
payouts.emptyHint: A payout appears when a vendor requests one from their earnings.
payouts.approveBody: Approving reserves the amount. It is not paid until you record a transaction reference.
payouts.rejectBody: The amount returns to the vendor's available balance. They see this reason.
payouts.payBody: Only do this once the transfer has actually left the bank. The reference is the only link between this record and the transfer.

cod.title: Cash collection
cod.subtitle: Cash riders are holding from COD orders, and what they have handed in.
cod.noBalancesHint: Every rider has handed in what they collected.
cod.settleBody: {name} is holding {amount} from {orders} order(s). Recording the deposit credits those vendors, so only do it once the cash is actually in.

commission.title: Commission
commission.subtitle: What the platform takes from each order.
commission.precedence: A rate is resolved as vendor rule first, then category, then global. A vendor rule silently beats a category one.
commission.fixedAtPlacement: The rate is fixed onto an order when it is placed, so changing a rule never alters an existing order. Use the effective-from date to schedule a change.
commission.emptyHint: Without at least a global rule, order placement fails with COMMISSION_NOT_CONFIGURED.
commission.addBody: The new rate applies to orders placed on or after its effective date.
commission.rateHint: A percentage, 0–100, up to 2 decimal places.
commission.effectiveFromHint: Leave as today to apply immediately, or pick a future date to schedule it.
commission.deleteBody: The {scope} rule for {target} at {rate} will be removed. Orders already placed keep the rate they were given.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.subtitle: Disputes customers have opened on delivered orders.
complaints.subject: Subject
complaints.emptyHint: A customer can open one complaint per delivered order.
complaints.replyPlaceholder: Reply to the customer and vendor…
complaints.refundBody: An online payment goes back through the original gateway. A cash order is recorded for you to repay by hand. This closes the complaint.
complaints.redoBody: A fresh pickup and drop job is created on the same order, so a rider will be dispatched again. This closes the complaint.
complaints.rejectBody: No money moves. The customer sees your note, so explain the decision.
complaints.notePlaceholder: What you decided and why — the customer reads this

promos.title: Promos
promos.subtitle: Discount codes customers can apply at checkout.
promos.emptyHint: Create a code and customers can apply it at checkout.
promos.addBody: Customers can apply this at checkout once it is live.
promos.editBody: The code and discount type cannot change once customers have it.
promos.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed after creation.
promos.typeLocked: The discount type cannot be changed after creation.
promos.maxDiscountHint: Caps a percentage discount. Leave blank for no cap.
promos.cityHint: Restrict to one city, or leave as all cities.
promos.enableBody: {code} becomes usable again inside its validity window.
promos.disableBody: {code} stops working at checkout immediately. Orders already placed with it keep their discount.
promos.deleteBody: {code} has been used {used} time(s). Deleting removes the code; orders that already used it keep their discount.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Messages sent to customers, vendors or riders in bulk.
announcements.composeBody: Preview the audience first — the send is checked against that count.
announcements.emptyHint: Send one and it appears here with its delivery count.
announcements.urduHint: People whose language is Urdu get this version. Provide both fields or neither.
announcements.urduBoth: Provide both the Urdu title and the Urdu message, or neither.
announcements.noRolesMeansAll: No role selected means customers, vendors and riders.
announcements.previewFirst: Preview the audience before sending. The count is checked by the server, so a stale preview is refused.
announcements.optOutNote: The difference is people who turned that channel off in their settings.
announcements.confirmBody: This messages {reachable} people over {channels}. It cannot be recalled.

analytics.title: Dashboard
analytics.subtitle: Orders, money and vendors across the platform.
analytics.gmvChartHint: What customers paid on delivered orders.
analytics.revenueChartHint: Our commission. Charted separately from GMV: the two are an order of magnitude apart.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Export orders, payments, payouts, cash and vendors.
reports.requestBody: It is built in the background. Nobody is emailed, so check back here.
reports.queued: Report queued. It appears here when ready.
reports.capNote: Capped at 250,000 rows. Phone numbers are masked and spreadsheet formulas are neutralised.
reports.emptyHint: Request one and it is built in the background.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action, append-only.
audit.emptyHint: Sensitive actions are recorded here as they happen.

admins.title: Admin users
admins.subtitle: Who can sign in to this panel, and what they can reach.
admins.rolesExplainer: Operations covers vendors, riders, dispatch, promos and announcements. Finance covers payouts, cash and commission. Support covers orders and complaints. Super admin covers everything, including this page, the audit log and queues.
admins.selfRule: You cannot change your own role or status, and the last active super admin cannot be removed.
admins.addBody: They sign in with this email and password.
admins.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Ask them to change it after first sign-in.
admins.deactivateBody: {name} is signed out everywhere immediately and cannot sign in again until reactivated.
admins.cannotSelf: You cannot change your own account.
admins.cannotLastSuper: This is the last active super admin.

cities.title: Cities
cities.subtitle: Delivery fee, order code and who delivers in each city.
cities.editBody: Changes take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
cities.deliveryFeeHint: Flat fee in PKR added to every order in this city. Shows in the next estimate.
cities.codeHint: 2–4 letters used in order numbers, e.g. LHR gives DHB-LHR-000123.
cities.courierHint: A courier partner takes over pickups and deliveries here instead of our riders.
cities.pauseBody: {name} disappears from customer search and no new addresses or vendors can be added to it. Its {vendors} vendor(s) stay as they are, and orders in progress are not cancelled.

queues.title: Queues
queues.subtitle: Background job health.
queues.retryBody: {count} failed job(s) on {queue} go back into the queue. Handlers are idempotent, so a retry cannot double-apply.
queues.dlqNote: Jobs that exhaust their retries stay in the failed set, which is the dead-letter store. Ops is alerted separately by email.

customer.tagline: Laundry and dry cleaning, picked up from your door.

home.noCity: We are not in your city yet.
home.noCityHint: We are working on it — check back soon.
home.cityLoadError: Could not load cities. Try again.
home.nextBody: Book a wash and we handle pickup through delivery.

orders.title: My orders
orders.emptyHint: Your orders will show up here.

login.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
login.notCustomer: This number belongs to a vendor or staff account. Use the right app.
login.invalidCode: That code is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a little while.
login.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
